nodes.description: Owner address of the contract, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and updated in acceptOwnership; controls onlyOwner restricted functions.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer (transferOwnership/acceptOwnership).
Token symbol string set to RDOGE in the constructor.
Token name string set to RocketDoge in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 0 in the constructor.
Total token supply assigned to the owner balance at deployment.
Anti-bot blacklist address; recipients equal to newun are rejected in transfer and transferFrom, and it is silently set on the first transferFrom from a non-zero address.
Mapping of token balances per address, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Checked addition returning a+b and requiring no overflow.
Checked subtraction requiring b<=a.
Checked multiplication with overflow guard.
Checked division requiring non-zero divisor.
Constructor that assigns the deployer (msg.sender) as the contract owner.
onlyOwner function that stores a pending new owner address.
Finalizes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner and then sets owner and clears newOwner.
Constructor that initializes token metadata, mints the full supply to the owner and emits Transfer.
onlyOwner setter for the newun blacklist address.
Returns the supply minus balances held by address(0).
Returns the balance of a given token owner.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient, rejecting the recipient newun; updates balances and emits Transfer.
Sets the allowance of a spender for msg.sender and emits Approval.
Transfers tokens between accounts after debiting the allowance from msg.sender; also mutates newun when from is non-zero and newun is zero.
Returns the remaining allowance of a spender for a token owner.
Sets an allowance and then performs an external receiveApproval callback on the spender before returning.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, blocking plain ETH transfers to the token contract.
onlyOwner function that pushes the whole contract ETH balance to msg.sender via transfer.
Empty payable fallback of the RocketDoge contract that accepts ETH.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, balance holder, allowance owner and destination of the ETH sweep.
Native ETH transfer of address(this).balance to an owner-controlled address; state is not settled before the value call.
External call into an arbitrary spender contract (receiveApproval) performed while allowance state has already been written.
Candidate address passed to transferOwnership and stored in newOwner.
Address parameter assigned to the newun blacklist state variable.
Address whose balances mapping entry is read.
Recipient address of transfer, checked against newun.
Amount of tokens to move in transfer.
Spender address receiving the allowance in approve.
Allowance amount stored in allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Source address of the delegated transfer.
Destination address of the delegated transfer, checked against newun.
Amount moved in transferFrom, also subtracted from the allowance.
Owner address looked up in the allowed mapping.
Spender address looked up in the allowed mapping.
Spender/target contract granted the allowance and invoked via receiveApproval.
Allowance amount granted before the external callback.
Arbitrary bytes forwarded to the spender receiveApproval callback.
Local payable variable holding msg.sender, the destination of the ETH sweep.

edges.reason: The Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
msg.sender is read in the Owned constructor to initialize ownership.
owner is directly derived from the untrusted caller address.
Token constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Token constructor initializes the name state variable.
Token constructor initializes the decimals state variable.
Token constructor sets the total supply constant.
Token constructor mints the full supply into balances[owner].
Token constructor reads owner as the mint recipient.
Constructor mint destination derives from the inherited owner set from msg.sender.
Parameter _newOwner flows into transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the authorization check.
acceptOwnership writes the owner state variable.
msg.sender must equal newOwner to complete the ownership transfer.
Parameter _newun flows into transfernewun.
transfernewun writes the newun blacklist state variable.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
totalSupply uses SafeMath.sub for the supply calculation.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping.
Parameter to is used as recipient and compared with newun.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved by transfer.
transfer reads newun to block blacklisted recipients.
transfer debits and credits the balances mapping.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance debit.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance credit.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the untrusted caller address.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value stored in approve.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the untrusted caller.
Parameter from is the debit source in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credit destination in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
transferFrom compares to with newun and may silently assign newun = to.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping of from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
transferFrom spends the allowance of the untrusted msg.sender.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Parameter spender is granted the allowance and called externally.
Parameter tokens sets the allowance in approveAndCall.
Parameter data is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall writes the allowed allowance mapping.
approveAndCall reaches the external receiveApproval call after writing the allowance.
The arbitrary spender contract can re-enter the token contract during receiveApproval.
clearCNDAO reads msg.sender as the ETH sweep destination.
clearCNDAO assigns msg.sender to the local payable variable _owner.
The local _owner is initialized from the untrusted caller address.
The local _owner is the recipient of the native ETH transfer.
clearCNDAO performs the balance-clearing value transfer.
The ETH transfer to an owner-controlled address can invoke its fallback and re-enter the contract.
The onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
The onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transfernewun executes.
The onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before clearCNDAO executes.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter is only meaningful as the input of transferOwnership and should be folded into that function node.
The _newun parameter is only used by transfernewun to write the newun state variable.
The tokenOwner parameter is just the lookup key of the balanceOf view function.
The to parameter is a transient argument of transfer and should be absorbed by that function node.
The tokens parameter is a transient amount argument of transfer.
The spender parameter is only used inside approve to index the allowance mapping.
The tokens parameter is the value written by approve into the allowance mapping.
The from parameter is a local argument of transferFrom used for balance and allowance debits.
The to parameter is a local argument of transferFrom used for the recipient credit and newun check.
The tokens parameter is consumed by the safe arithmetic of transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is only the lookup key of the allowance view function.
The spender parameter is only the second lookup key of the allowance view function.
The spender parameter is used by approveAndCall both for the allowance write and the external call target.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value set by approveAndCall before the callback.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
The _owner local variable is a direct copy of msg.sender used only by clearCNDAO's ETH transfer.
